solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Fighting drained divorcees with joint custody (8)

indicators.note: a drained vessel has only its shell left, so only the outer letters of the word survive

blocks.note: fighting = war
DIVORCEES emptied to its first and last letters
the hip is a joint

annotation.surface: A bitter separation in which the exhausted ex-spouses are still battling over shared custody of the children.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface makes "joint custody" one legal phrase; it splits, with "joint" going into the wordplay and "custody" alone as the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: A ward of court is a child placed under the court's protection, and that guardianship is the custody meant.

entries.clue: Tube attached to pump coming up through that road (5)

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means reading from bottom to top
the answer runs through the words, hidden across them

blocks.note: letters sitting inside thAT ROAd

annotation.surface: A plumber describes a hose fixed to a pump, running up under a road.
annotation.walkthrough: The pump is the heart; the surface keeps it mechanical so the anatomy stays out of sight.
annotation.definitionFit: The aorta is the great artery leaving the heart, a tube joined to the body's pump.

entries.clue: Stay outside in desperate agitation (9)

indicators.note: only the outside of the word is taken, its first and last letters

blocks.note: the outside letters of DESPERATE
a ferment is a state of agitation

annotation.surface: Someone is left standing outdoors, frantic and agitated.
annotation.walkthrough: "Stay" reads as a verb, but it is the noun of a legal stay, a postponement.
annotation.definitionFit: A legal stay suspends or postpones proceedings, so it is a putting-off.

entries.clue: Hail Tesla driven by club (3)

blocks.note: hi is a greeting, a hail
T is the symbol for the tesla, the unit of magnetic flux density

annotation.surface: Someone waves at a Tesla car being driven by a member of some club.
annotation.walkthrough: Tesla looks like the car maker; it is the physics unit, symbol T.
annotation.definitionFit: Past participle sense: a golf ball driven by a club has been struck, the plain synonym.

entries.clue: Columnar entry helping mostly with entry of cents (7)

indicators.note: most of the word, so its last letter goes
the letter enters, going inside the other word

blocks.note: PORTION, a helping, without its last letter
c = cents

annotation.surface: A dictionary entry about columns, padded out with help and a few cents.
annotation.walkthrough: "Entry" appears twice with two jobs: a doorway in the definition, an insertion in the wordplay.
annotation.definitionFit: A portico is a porch with columns at a building's entrance.

entries.clue: Eg brilliant Arab abridged Talmudic text (6)

indicators.note: shortened, so the last letter is cut

blocks.note: a brilliant is a cut diamond, a gem
ARAB losing its last letter

annotation.surface: A clever Arab scholar produces a condensed version of a Talmudic text.
annotation.walkthrough: "Brilliant" looks like an adjective praising the Arab; it is a noun, the diamond cut.
annotation.definitionFit: The Gemara is the rabbinical commentary on the Mishnah that together with it makes up the Talmud.

entries.clue: Napoleonic forces, God help us, within range at sea (6,5)

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other
confused, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: RANGE rearranged
dear me! is an exclamation of dismay, like God help us

annotation.surface: An alarmed observer sees Napoleon's forces arrayed within range out at sea.
annotation.walkthrough: DEAR ME goes inside GRAN_E, between the N and the final E.
annotation.definitionFit: The Grande Armée was Napoleon's main army.

entries.clue: Root vegetable I threaten to pull up (5)

indicators.note: in a down clue, pulling up means reading from the bottom upwards

blocks.note: to loom is to threaten, so I LOOM

annotation.surface: A gardener glares at a root vegetable, threatening to pull it up.
annotation.walkthrough: Pulling up is exactly what one does to a root vegetable, so the indicator hides in plain sight.
annotation.definitionFit: Mooli is a long white radish, also called daikon.

entries.clue: Scrupulous engineers likely to start action without it? (9)

indicators.note: lacking, so IT is taken out

blocks.note: RE = Royal Engineers

blocks.clueFragment: likely to start action without it
blocks.note: LITIGIOUS, quick to start legal action, without IT

annotation.surface: A question about whether careful engineers might begin work without some component.
annotation.walkthrough: The action is legal action, and the word to find is LITIGIOUS before IT comes out.
annotation.definitionFit: Religious can mean scrupulous or conscientious, as in religiously careful.

entries.clue: Good work to improve image of tech department (6)

blocks.note: PR, public relations, is work done to improve an image
kept as printed
the IT department

annotation.surface: Praise for a project that polished the reputation of a company's tech department.
annotation.walkthrough: "Good" reads as an adjective praising the work; it is the noun, a benefit.
annotation.definitionFit: Good as a noun, as in for your own good, is benefit or profit.

entries.clue: Academic opens early novel that can’t be written over (4-4)

indicators.note: the academic opens the other word up by going inside it
new, so the letters take a new arrangement

blocks.note: EARLY rearranged
a don is a university lecturer

annotation.surface: A professor opens an early novel whose text is fixed and cannot be amended.
annotation.walkthrough: "Novel" is the book in the surface; it is the rearrangement signal, and "opens" has the academic split the shuffled letters rather than stand in front.
annotation.definitionFit: A read-only file or disc cannot be written over.

entries.clue: Passable tune piper’s son interrupts on the violin (4,2,8)

indicators.note: breaks into the other word, sitting inside it

blocks.note: an air is a tune
Tom, Tom, the piper's son, from the English nursery rhyme
playing the fiddle

annotation.surface: A folk musician's middling tune on the violin is cut into by the piper's boy.
annotation.walkthrough: Tom, Tom, the piper's son is an English nursery rhyme; the tune and the son sit together inside the violin-playing, just after its first letter.
annotation.definitionFit: Fair to middling means moderately good, passable.

entries.clue: Very high, as lower jumping got? (4,3,4)

blocks.note: delighted, on a high
in the nursery rhyme Hey Diddle Diddle, the cow leapt clean past the moon

annotation.surface: A puzzled comparison of heights, as if something lower could jump higher.
annotation.walkthrough: A lower here is not something less high but a cow, an animal that lows (moos).
annotation.definitionFit: Over the moon means extremely happy, and it is literally very high up.

entries.clue: This on road’s verges being cut? (4)

definitions.text: This on road’s verges being cut?

indicators.note: the verges, the word's edge letters, are cut off

blocks.note: STREET, a road, with its outer letters S and T trimmed away

annotation.surface: A council notice about what gets felled when roadside verges are cut back.
annotation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue describes a tree on a verge; read as wordplay, the road is STREET and cutting its verges strips the S and T.
annotation.definitionFit: Trees on road verges are exactly what gets cut back with them.

entries.clue: Nearly influence sound of group singing Get Back (9)

indicators.note: almost all of the word, so its last letter goes
what is heard, not what is written

blocks.note: REACH, as in range of influence, without its last letter
quire is an old spelling of choir, pronounced the same

annotation.surface: Talk of a singing group almost influenced by the Beatles song Get Back.
annotation.walkthrough: The capitals dress "Get Back" as the Beatles song; it is the plain verb.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to get something back is to obtain it again.

entries.clue: English bully arrived and overturned Ireland’s green champion (3-7)

indicators.note: turned over, so read backwards

blocks.note: E = English
to cow someone is to bully them
arr. = arrived, as on a timetable
ROI = Republic of Ireland

annotation.surface: A rugby report: an English bruiser upset Ireland's champion on the green.
annotation.walkthrough: "Green" suggests Ireland's colour; here it means environmentalist.
annotation.definitionFit: An eco-warrior is a militant campaigner for the environment, a green champion.

entries.clue: Chaser o’er ground? (9)

indicators.note: crushed, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

annotation.surface: A poetic glimpse of a steeplechaser racing over the turf.
annotation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a chaser is a steeplechase horse, and the ground is the turf it races o'er.
annotation.definitionFit: A chaser, a horse bred for steeplechasing, is a racehorse.

entries.clue: Don’t eat then run — intake likely to rise (4,6)

blocks.note: to fast is to go without food
a run is a small stream

annotation.surface: Advice for a diet: skip the meal, go running, and watch your calorie intake that would otherwise rise.
annotation.walkthrough: The Fast Stream is the British civil service's scheme for graduates marked out for quick promotion.
annotation.definitionFit: Fast Stream recruits are an intake expected to rise rapidly.

entries.clue: Full collection of awards saw boost to confidence (3-4)

blocks.note: an EGOT is winning an Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony
to rip is to saw along the grain, as with a ripsaw

annotation.surface: An entertainer who won every major award saw it do wonders for their confidence.
annotation.walkthrough: "Saw" looks like the past of see; it is the cutting verb.
annotation.definitionFit: An ego trip is something done to boost one's self-regard.

entries.clue: Tender like husband after Francesca’s heart (4)

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle letter

blocks.note: the middle letter of FRANCESCA
like = as
h = husband

annotation.surface: A husband pining tenderly after Francesca's heart.
annotation.walkthrough: "After" puts the rest after C. "Tender" is not affectionate but legal tender.
annotation.definitionFit: Cash is legal tender, money offered in payment.

entries.clue: Remarkable feat left eight men so shattered (5,9)

indicators.note: broken to pieces, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: quit = left
EIGHT MEN SO rearranged

annotation.surface: A rowing crew's heroic effort left all eight men exhausted.
annotation.walkthrough: "Shattered" in the surface means exhausted, and the eight men are a rowing eight.
annotation.definitionFit: An idiom of admiration: anything impressive, a feat included, can be called this.

entries.clue: Still popular, Marc Bolan’s band briefly making comeback (5)

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter goes
coming back, so read backwards

blocks.note: in = fashionable, popular
T REX, Marc Bolan's glam-rock band, cut short

annotation.surface: A music columnist notes that T. Rex are still popular and briefly staging a comeback.
annotation.walkthrough: "Still" reads as yet; it is the adjective, motionless.
annotation.definitionFit: Inert means still, without movement.

entries.clue: From report, immediately feel sorry for tiny country (5)

indicators.note: going by what is heard, not what is written

blocks.note: now = immediately, rue = feel sorry for

annotation.surface: A news report prompts instant sympathy for a tiny nation.
annotation.walkthrough: Nauru, a Pacific island state, is one of the smallest countries in the world.
annotation.definitionFit: Nauru is a very small island republic in the Pacific.

entries.clue: Spooner’s dreadful quartet escape in heated situation (4,4)

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words

blocks.note: dire = dreadful, four = quartet; swap the D and F sounds

annotation.surface: Four terrible people make a getaway when things get heated.
annotation.walkthrough: "Heated situation" sounds figurative, an argument; it is a literal fire.
annotation.definitionFit: A fire door is a way out when a building is burning.

entries.clue: 25 per cent off duke’s inferior brand (6)

indicators.note: a quarter of the letters are removed: two of eight, from the end

blocks.note: MARQUESS, the rank just below a duke, losing SS, two of its eight letters

annotation.surface: A cheap discount brand is sold at a quarter off in a duke's shop.
annotation.walkthrough: "Inferior brand" looks like one phrase; "inferior" belongs with the duke and "brand" stands alone.
annotation.definitionFit: Marque is the French-derived word for a make, used mostly of cars, so a brand.

entries.clue: Coat with supernatural powers saving US soldier (3)

indicators.note: saving means except, so the soldier is left out

blocks.note: MAGIC = supernatural powers, except GI, the US soldier

annotation.surface: A magic cloak whose powers once saved an American soldier.
annotation.walkthrough: "Saving" suggests rescue; it means except, so GI comes out of MAGIC. A mac is a raincoat.
annotation.definitionFit: A mac, short for mackintosh, is a waterproof coat.

entries.clue: Mass begun by male or female bell-ringer, sometimes (6)

indicators.note: the second piece is started off by the first, which goes in front

blocks.note: male or female is a sex
a ton is a unit of mass

annotation.surface: A church scene: Mass is started by a bell-ringer, who may be a man or a woman.
annotation.walkthrough: Mass looks like the church service, which suits the bell-ringer; it is weight. "Begun by" puts SEX first.
annotation.definitionFit: A sexton looks after a church and sometimes rings its bells.

entries.clue: Mischief-maker turned saintly to prepare for smack (6,2)

indicators.note: turned round, so read backwards

blocks.note: Puck is the mischievous sprite of A Midsummer Night's Dream
saintly = pure

annotation.surface: A former troublemaker has reformed and braces for a slap.
annotation.walkthrough: The smack is not a slap but a kiss, a smacker.
annotation.definitionFit: You pucker up your lips to prepare for a kiss.
